author: Momo-Javid
description: Local MCP server that gives your AI coding tools a whole team of models. Ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity directly, have them debate and cross-verify one another, analyze entire codebases, and run multi-agent crews and iterative workflows — all coordinated by a local Agent Hub.
name: Proxima

tools.name: ask_chatgpt
tools.title: Ask ChatGPT
tools.description: Send a message to ChatGPT specifically. Use ask_model for any other/BYOK provider, smart_query to auto-pick the best provider, or ask_all_ais to query several at once.

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50". For large files, always specify relevant line ranges only.

tools.name: ask_claude
tools.title: Ask Claude
tools.description: Send a message to Claude specifically (strong at coding/reasoning). Use ask_model for other/BYOK providers, smart_query to auto-pick, or ask_all_ais for several at once.

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50". For large files, always specify relevant line ranges only.

tools.name: ask_gemini
tools.title: Ask Gemini
tools.description: Send a message to Gemini specifically. Use ask_model for other/BYOK providers, smart_query to auto-pick, or ask_all_ais for several at once.

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50". For large files, always specify relevant line ranges only.

tools.name: ask_perplexity
tools.title: Ask Perplexity
tools.description: Send a message to Perplexity specifically (best for web search + citations). Use ask_model for other/BYOK providers, or deep_search for structured research.

message.description: Message to send to Perplexity (best for web search + citations)

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50". For large files, always specify relevant line ranges only.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.title: Ask Any Model
tools.description: Universal chat: send a message to ANY enabled provider by name (the 4 session providers OR any configured BYOK provider). Use this when you need a provider other than the four dedicated ask_* tools.

provider.description: Provider name. Currently available: perplexity, chatgpt, claude, gemini

model.description: Specific model ID override (uses provider default if omitted)

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50".

tools.name: ask_all_ais
tools.title: Ask All AIs
tools.description: Send the SAME message to multiple providers in parallel and get every answer side by side. Use for breadth/comparison; for a single best answer use smart_query.

message.description: Message to send to multiple AI providers

providers.description: Which providers to use (default: all enabled). e.g. ["chatgpt", "nvidia"]

files.description: Optional: file paths to include as context

tools.name: smart_query
tools.title: Smart Query (auto-route)
tools.description: Best general entry point: auto-routes to the best provider and can verify/cross-check. Modes: auto (fast single AI), verify (primary + cross-model check), consensus (all vote), collaborate (role-based teamwork).

message.description: Message to send - auto-routes to best provider

preferredProvider.description: Preferred provider (optional - auto-selects if not set)

files.description: Optional: Array of file paths to include as context

mode.description: Execution mode: auto (default, fast single AI), verify (primary + verifier), consensus (all AIs vote), collaborate (role-based teamwork)

tools.name: new_conversation
tools.title: New Conversation (reset)
tools.description: Reset conversation memory/context for a provider (or all enabled providers if none named). Use when you want a fresh thread with no prior context.

provider.description: Which provider to reset: chatgpt, claude, gemini, or perplexity. If omitted, resets all enabled providers.

tools.name: verify_code
tools.title: Verify Code
tools.description: Quick best-practices check of a code snippet for a stated purpose (bugs, security, improvements). For a whole file/folder use analyze_file; for a deep vulnerability audit use security_audit.

purpose.description: Description of what the code should do

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: explain_code
tools.title: Explain Code
tools.description: Explain a code snippet (or files) in detail, line by line. Use this to understand existing code; use analyze_file for large files/whole codebases.

code.description: The code snippet to explain (or use files parameter)

files.description: Optional: Array of file paths containing code to explain

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: generate_code
tools.title: Generate Code
tools.description: Write new, production-ready code from a description (with comments, error handling, usage examples). For converting existing code use convert_code; for fixing an error use fix_error.

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: optimize_code
tools.title: Optimize Code
tools.description: Improve existing code for a goal (speed, memory, readability) and show before/after. For correctness bugs use fix_error; for security use security_audit.

code.description: Code to optimize (or use files parameter)

files.description: Optional: Array of file paths containing code to optimize

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: review_code
tools.title: Review Code (snippet)
tools.description: Review a code snippet for bugs, security, performance and best practices. For a single file on disk use review_code_file; for a folder use analyze_file.

code.description: Code to review (or use files parameter)

files.description: Optional: Array of file paths containing code to review

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: solve
tools.title: Solve Coding Task
tools.description: End-to-end solve a coding task/feature/bug with full working code. Broadest tool: use generate_code for greenfield code, fix_error for a specific error message.

task.description: What to solve — coding task, bug, feature, anything

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: fix_error
tools.title: Fix Error
tools.description: Diagnose a specific error message/stack trace and give the exact fix (root cause → fix → prevention → full code). For a general explanation only, use explain_error.

file.description: File path where the error occurs

context.description: Additional context about what you were doing

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: build_architecture
tools.title: Build Architecture
tools.description: Design a complete, production-ready system architecture (stack, schema, APIs, deployment) from a project description.

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: write_tests
tools.title: Write Tests
tools.description: Generate a complete test file for the code in a given file path (happy path + edge cases + error scenarios).

file.description: File path to generate tests for

framework.description: Test framework (jest, vitest, mocha, pytest). Default: auto-detect

focus.description: Focus area: unit, integration, edge-cases, all

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.title: Explain Error
tools.description: Explain an error in plain language with likely causes and step-by-step fixes. For the exact code fix instead, use fix_error.

error.description: Error message or stack trace to explain

context.description: What you were doing when the error occurred

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select.

tools.name: convert_code
tools.title: Convert Code
tools.description: Translate existing code from one language/framework to another, preserving all functionality. For writing new code from scratch use generate_code.

code.description: Code snippet to convert (if no file)

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: security_audit
tools.title: Security Audit
tools.description: Deep security audit of code (injection, auth, secrets, crypto, config, deps) with severity, location and fixes. For general code review use review_code.

code.description: Code to audit for security vulnerabilities

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding.

tools.name: deep_search
tools.title: Deep Search (AI research)
tools.description: AI-powered research with typed prompts (web, reddit, github, news, math, academic, factcheck, stats). Best for sourced research; for a raw page fetch use web_scrape, for raw links use ddg_search.

type.description: Search type (default: web). reddit, github, news, math, academic, factcheck, stats

language.description: For github: programming language filter (e.g., JavaScript, Python)

files.description: Optional: file paths for context. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50"

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select

tools.name: get_ui_reference
tools.title: UI/UX Design Reference
tools.description: Get a premium UI/UX design reference (colors, typography, layout, components, a11y), optionally improving existing code. For general code generation use generate_code.

description.description: Describe the UI/UX you need — what kind of page, component, layout, or design style you want

code.description: Optional: existing code to analyze and apply design improvements on

files.description: Optional: file paths of existing code to improve with better UI/UX. Supports line ranges like "path/file.js:10-50"

style.description: Design style preference: modern, minimal, glassmorphism, dark, corporate, playful, etc.

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select best for coding

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.title: Web Scrape (URL → Markdown)
tools.description: Fetch a single URL and convert the page to clean Markdown (SSRF-guarded). Use for a known page; use ddg_search to find URLs, or deep_search for AI research.

url.description: URL to scrape and convert to markdown

tools.name: ddg_search
tools.title: DuckDuckGo Search (free links)
tools.description: Free web search via DuckDuckGo returning ranked title/URL/snippet results (no API key). Use to find pages; use web_scrape to read one, or deep_search for AI-synthesized research.

tools.name: content
tools.title: Content (write / summarize / analyze)
tools.description: General text/content tool: summarize, write, brainstorm, howto, analyze, extract, or improve. For code use the code tools; for research with sources use deep_search.

action.description: Action: summarize (URL/text), write (article), brainstorm (ideas), howto (step-by-step guide), analyze (document/URL), extract (data from text), improve (writing help)

input.description: Main input — URL, topic, text, or task description

detail.description: Extra context — focus area, writing style, data type to extract, specific question

body.description: Content body — text to improve, or content to analyze/extract from

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select

tools.name: compare
tools.title: Compare Two Things
tools.description: Compare two items/options/technologies side by side, optionally for a given context.

provider.description: AI provider: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider. Default: auto-select

tools.name: debate
tools.title: Multi-AI Debate
tools.description: Have multiple providers argue DIFFERENT stances on a topic (one stance each), then conclude. Needs 2+ enabled providers for true multi-AI; otherwise one AI covers all sides.

tools.name: verify
tools.title: Verify Claim (cross-AI)
tools.description: Ask one or more providers to answer a question/claim with a confidence rating and caveats. Use to fact-check or cross-check an answer across providers.

providers.description: Optional: specific providers to use for verification

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.title: Clear Response Cache
tools.description: Clear the in-memory provider response cache so the next identical question is re-asked fresh instead of returning a cached answer.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.title: Analyze File / Codebase
tools.description: Analyze a file OR a whole directory (auto codebase-packing, smart-slicing, symbol extraction, grep, secret scan). Best for large files/folders; for a quick snippet use explain_code/review_code.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file or directory to analyze

provider.description: Which AI to use (chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider). Default: claude

grep.description: Optional regex pattern to search within the file/codebase before analysis

symbols.description: Comma-separated function/class names to extract from file. E.g. "smartChat,toolResponse,guardrails". Auto-resolves dependencies.

tools.name: review_code_file
tools.title: Review Code File
tools.description: Review a single code file on disk for issues and improvements (optionally focused on bugs/performance/security/style). For a whole folder use analyze_file; for a pasted snippet use review_code.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the code file to review

focus.description: What to focus on (bugs, performance, security, style)

provider.description: Which AI to use (chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, or any configured BYOK provider). Default: claude

tools.name: show_window
tools.title: Show Agent Hub Window
tools.description: Make the Proxima Agent Hub window visible (no effect on chat).

tools.name: hide_window
tools.title: Hide Agent Hub Window
tools.description: Hide the Proxima Agent Hub window (keeps running in the background; MCP still works).

tools.name: toggle_window
tools.title: Toggle Agent Hub Window
tools.description: Toggle the Proxima Agent Hub window between visible and hidden.

tools.name: set_headless_mode
tools.title: Set Headless Mode
tools.description: Enable/disable headless mode (Agent Hub runs in the background without a visible window; MCP keeps working).

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.title: Run Workflow (sequential)
tools.description: Run an ordered multi-step pipeline where each step's output feeds the next, auto-routing each step to a provider. Use for fixed sequential pipelines; use run_loop to iterate one task to convergence, crew for role-based agents.

provider.description: Which AI to use (auto-routed if empty)

steps.description: Array of workflow steps. Each step output feeds into next step.

tools.name: run_loop
tools.title: Run Loop (iterate to quality)
tools.description: Iterate ONE task: generate → another AI reviews → improve, until it converges or hits maxTurns. Use to refine a single output; use run_workflow for distinct sequential steps.

provider.description: Primary AI provider (auto-routed if empty)

reviewProvider.description: AI to review output (defaults to claude)

tools.name: crew
tools.title: Multi-Agent Crew
tools.description: Run a role-based pipeline (default Researcher→Writer→Reviewer), each role on its own provider, passing output down the chain. Use for role-specialized teamwork; use run_workflow for plain sequential tasks.

task.description: Task for the multi-agent crew to execute

provider.description: AI provider for this agent

tools.name: proxima_cost_report
tools.title: Proxima Cost Report
tools.description: Show this session's token usage and estimated money saved (per provider). Read-only observability.

tools.name: proxima_agentic_status
tools.title: Proxima Agentic Status
tools.description: Full status of the agentic pipeline: current mode (session/BYOK), router/provider health, memory, run-loop, orchestrator and cost. Read-only diagnostics.
